what_differs: WagerTech decided that BAs may only use the notes field on assigned redeposits and must not edit name, book, amount or slot fields; changes go through ops. No ticket states this permission rule; WAGR-464 still lists 'Can BAs create their own redeposit rows, or only Ops?' as open.
suggested_action: Suggestion: record the BA edit restriction on WAGR-464 and include field-level security or locking in the redeposit build stories.
